10011201.t: Harmony Pavilion
Ah... Dear customer, please calm down!
What is all the commotion?

L-Lady Dan Xi. The thing is... there are so many customers that the head chef collapsed.
And we still have so many orders to serve...

Is that all you are fretting over?
Fret not, for we shall take care of it for you!

What?
Hey, I don't know how to cook Quartet cuisine or anything like that.

Does it really have to be Quartet cuisine?
What they are eating is no mere dish.
They are eating 'information'!
Dropping a line straight out of a cooking manga out of nowhere...

Alright, fine. Got nothing to lose anyway, so let's give it a shot.
What's on the menu that needs to go out?
Yes, the guests ordered black tea and a noodle dish!
Then tell me, my friend, which would you like me to handle?
Noodle dish

Very well, my friend.
I shall whip up the finest noodle dish in the Quartet!
Guess I'll get the black tea ready, then...
A moment later.
Here, the black tea's ready.

Hmm...? They do not seem pleased.
My friend, did you happen to add sugar?
Don't you just pour milk into brewed tea?

Mmm... My friend, black tea turns bitter if steeped too long.
And you must add sugar along with the milk to bring out the flavor.

Normally people can just have it to their own taste...
but we can hardly serve it like this in a shop.

Man...
I didn't know that much.
Hehe, what cannot be helped cannot be helped.
Then for now, I shall have them taste my cooking instead.
Wait, what did you make?

Are you curious?
Hehe...

Behold...
a Quartet specialty, Purgatory Malatang Noodles!
...Purgatory?

Oh dear...
Was it too spicy?

That's way past spicy—it looks like they took actual damage.
Are you sure you didn't make a lethal weapon instead of food?
We should probably give them some water at least...

Indeed. Milk is the finest remedy for spice!
Wait... Aah?!

W-Wait a moment... Nothing comes out... of there yet.
So please... Hnngh?!
In the end, Dan Xi was only let go after being thoroughly ravaged by the furious aberrant spirits for a long while...
Black tea

Black tea, you say? Very well.
Wait just a moment. I happened to acquire some fine tea leaves, so...
Oh dear, we are all out of milk!

We've got milk right here, don't we?
Wonder how many cups we can get out of those?
Aahn♡ Truly, what a mischievous fellow you are.

Still...
Hmm, wait just a moment.

Here is the black tea.
Go ahead, give it a try.
...Is it handmade?

Hehe, who knows?
Would you care for a sip as well?
If you're offering, I can't refuse.

The bitterness of the black tea and the sweet, rich thickness of the milk gently coat my mouth...
We could actually sell this.
Goodness, I could never make enough to sell.

A-Anyway.
Have you finished your cooking, my friend?

Just finished.
Humanitas-style noodles.

Hehe, they must have loved it. Passing on to the afterlife after a single bite!
Did you put some kind of secret sauce in it?

Depends on what you call a secret.
I used store-bought sauce.

Store-bought sauce...?
Does that not make it instant ramen?

I'm not even a cook in the first place.
Store-bought sauce beats an amateur's cooking any day.

Hehe... Just as I expected of my friend.
You have a keen grasp of the fundamentals of business.

10011202.t: Sky Lantern Street
Aberrant spirits were chasing customers away from a prize draw stall.
What's going on? Why are they so worked up?

Ack! Please help me!
These guys have been chasing away all my customers, and I can't do any business!
Why?
Well, they said they wanted to try the draw, so I let them pull a few times, and now they're throwing a fit just because they didn't get the prize they wanted!
(...This merchant is lying.)
Hmm...
What do you want to do, <:player>?
Do the draw for them
Kouchou, want to give it a pull?
Alright.
Ah, please wait just a second!
Phew, alright, go right ahead!
Something's fishy...

Whoa, we have a winner!
Congratulations!

I actually won it...
What do I do now?
...Here, you can have it.

Ah... Wait...!
Was this not what you wanted...?

Hngh... N-Not there...!
I'm not hiding anything in there...!
Kouchou was thoroughly ravaged by the angry aberrant spirits...
Perform a ritual for luck
You know what they say—if you want to pull something, you've gotta draw it first.
Draw it...?
Yep, draw it and it shall come!

Then...
I'll draw that plushie.

Alright...
I'm pulling now, okay?
Kouchou tried the draw, but didn't get the prize she wanted.
...Didn't get it.

Well, some days are just like that...
Hm?

Hey, hold on.
Something's weird about this drawing—
That plushie didn't even have a string attached to it in the first place!??!

Gah?!
H-How did you...

The aberrant spirits can see from above.
So I drew it from several different angles.
...Scams will not be tolerated at a festival hosted by the Orchid Clan.
In the name of the Fairwinds Association, I will punish you.
Eeeeek?!
And so, the festival merchant was hauled away...

I know this hardly makes up for the trouble, but...
here's the plushie you were trying to win.

10011203.t: Attendants from the Quartet were milling about with gloomy faces.

What's the matter? Did you lose your wallets?
The Lost and Found is at the entrance to the festival street—
Nah, it's not that. We're just bored out of our minds!
We've already been to pretty much every festival out there, so there aren't any games left we haven't played.
We figured there might be something fun to do since the vibe's different this time, but it's all just kid stuff, isn't it?

Spoken like true festival veterans.
Well, I guess that makes sense if they're from the Quartet.
This is troubling. The Quartet's festival is meant to bolster yang energy and drive away impure energy...
If people find the festival boring, that effect will weaken.
<:player>, what kind of plan would you come up with to resolve this?
Attack the pavilion
...Are you out of your mind?

I'm completely sane, thank you very much.
Let's give them the kind of excitement they've never experienced in their lives.

Oh my? What brings you... here...?
Hehe... Have you finally come to be with Mama...
Shh!

Help me out here.
You like a 'true festival,' don't you?

A-Alright... Hehe.
If it's for you, I'll gladly... offer you... Mama's body...
Yeah, no, I don't need your body.

Wh-What is this...?
This place feels so... gloomy and... chilling...!
I didn't even get chills like this during the kunoichi exam...

Hehehehe...
Who's been... a naughty child...?
I-It's...
A ghooooost?!
Hehe... Show my children... how delicious your souls taste...
Now then, do have a wonderful time...

Ngh...?! Wh-What is this...?
It's all sticky and... squishy!

Haa...!
They never taught us about anything like this... at the kunoichi academy...!
Something's wriggling inside... It feels weird... Haaahn?!
M-Me too...! Something's getting... under my clothes...! H-Haaahn?!
A moment later.
Hmm, guess it's about time to get them out.

How was that?
A totally brand-new experience, right?
Th-That was... my first time... Hwaaah...
Th-That might... not be so bad... Haaahn...♡
Come up with a plan for them
Guess I have no choice... Kage, lend me a hand.
Hmm, I suppose there's no helping it. Where have you been so far?
Well, for starters... the ghost cafe, and the haunted attraction...
What about the Halloween puppet theater?

Already went there too.
The plot was way more predictable than I thought.

Hmm...
Then how about the shooting gallery next to it?

I already broke the high score there.
Though this one here couldn't hit a single target!
I-I hit one, okay?!

Hmm... That's a problem.
It seems you've already seen everything the festival has to offer.
At this rate, my plans will be useless too.
Urgh...
The four of us put our heads together, but couldn't come up with any good ideas...

10011204.t: Sky Lantern Street
Aberrant spirits had taken over the photo booth and were getting in the way of anyone trying to take pictures...
Alright, taking the picture now! One, two!

Did it turn out well?
Let's see...

Aah!
There's something behind us!
This isn't a souvenir photo, it's a ghost photo?!
The aberrant spirits are interfering with the picture-taking.

Photographs are memories and remembrances...
I do not wish to let them ruin that.

Fixer...
Could you tell me how we might resolve this?
Stop the aberrant spirits from interfering

Understood...
Then I shall hold the aberrant spirits back with my own power...

Really?
Alright... I'm taking it again, okay?
Okay, get ready—
...Halt!
...This should do it... Huh?

Ah... Fixer, there are... too many aberrant spirits.
With my power alone, I cannot...

W-Wait...
What are you doing?

Ghk...?!
Hey, it's got the camera...

W-Wait...!
Do not take pictures of me... in such a shameful state...!
Chise ended up having humiliating photos of her defeat taken...
Start a photo shoot
...Do we really need to stop them?

Pardon?
Fixer, what do you mean by that...

The whole point is making memories, right? Then let's give them plenty.
Unforgettable memories packed into every frame.
Alright, you stand on the left, and you move a bit to the right... Don't slouch, chin up... Great, hold it right there.

Fixer...
What should I do here?

Hang on a second.
It's not your turn yet.

Hey, aberrant spirit over there! Get in a little closer.
It won't look like a proper haunting from that far away!

Alright, everyone hold still...
Chise, freeze!

Understood...
I need only freeze the moisture in the air, yes...?

Ah...!
Did it just get chilly all of a sudden...?

I'm cold... I'm hungry...
Eek! I have a really creepy feeling about this...!

Nice! One spooky souvenir ghost photo, complete.
Go ahead and take a look.

The aberrant spirits...
have vanished into the photograph.

...Wait, is it that old superstition?
The one where taking a photo steals your soul...
Perhaps... my power and... the excitement of the festival... had an effect... on them...?
So does this count as helping them pass on, too...?

10011205.t: Aberrant spirits were gathered in the Hundred Schools of Thought Classroom, chanting some suspicious spell...

Hey!
What are you doing in a sacred classroom?

Oh, ahem...
Really? That sounds fun!
What is it?
<:player>, have you heard of the [Seven Wonders of the Hundred Schools of Thought]?
How would I know about that?
Oh, come on! Every school has at least one story like that!

...Honestly, the fact that the Hundred Schools of Thought has seven wonders is a wonder in itself.
Do you actually believe in that stuff?

Huh?
Of course I don't!
It's just fun researching how superstitions and ghost stories get passed down and spread around!

Put it like that, and it actually makes some sense.
So?
So! Apparently these guys sensed some suspicious energy in the Hundred Schools of Thought, and they want permission to investigate it!
Let me get this straight... Aberrant spirits felt a suspicious spiritual presence... in the Hundred Schools of Thought Classroom... and they're asking to investigate it?

Yep!
It's an activity for the Aberrant Spirit Detective Case Observation Club!
...I don't even know where to start poking holes in this, but I get the gist.
Hehe! Then what should we investigate first?
The mirror that reflects a suspicious person
Alright, number one! The mirror that reflects a suspicious person!
A suspicious person?

Yeah! They say if you look in the mirror late at night...
You'll see 'someone who shouldn't exist' staring back at you!!
Someone who shouldn't exist, huh...
Well, we'll find out once we check it out.

The full-length mirror in the Hundred Schools of Thought Classroom...
Let's see what shows up in it, shall we?

I-It's...
It's heeeeere?!
What is?

A g-g-g-ghoooost!
[Something that shouldn't exist]!!
Eeeeek! I knew it, something that shouldn't exist is right here...! Begone, evil spirit! Begone, evil spirit! Take <:player> instead of me, please! I don't taste good!

What nonsense are you spouting?!
And sneaking into the classroom at this hour without permission, no less...
It's fortunate I was the one on night patrol—what would you have done if someone else had caught you?
Wait, so the figure in the mirror at night was...
It was probably just my reflection while I was making my rounds.
...Tch, how boring.

Are you seriously complaining to me about that?!
Stop talking nonsense and come out of there at once.

You too, <:player>, hurry up and come out!
If you stay in there like that, a 'real' ghost might come and snatch you away, you know?
...Yeah, alright.
The 13 Steps of Fear

The staircase in the central corridor of the Hundred Schools of Thought...
Rumor has it there are 12 steps during the day, but at night, there are 13!

And that 13th step...
supposedly leads to the underworld, so once you step on it, you can never come back.
Over here, right here!

That's... a lot of steps, though?
Forget 13, there's way more than 12 here.

Ahaha, don't sweat the small stuff!
If you nitpick every little detail in a ghost story, we'll be here all night!

That's not nitpicking, the whole premise is flat-out wrong.
Why 13 in the first place, anyway?
...Maybe because it's a prime number?
Like that's the only prime number out there?
Hmph! Keep poking holes and I'm going up without you!
One, two, three... <:player>, make sure you keep a close eye on me, okay?
Yeah, yeah, I'm watching, I'm watching.

Ten, eleven...
And...
Hold on.
Hwah?

Whoa, they vanished?!
Wait, does it really lead to the underworld?!

Hmm, so this was the place.
Where the boundary was destabilized...

Huh? Jia?
What brings you here?
What do you think? I was investigating the extent of the boundary in place of a certain someone who's been slacking off.
By the looks of it, the staircase at the Hundred Schools of Thought marked the boundary between this side and the other.
Oh, so our little friends from earlier...

They didn't go to the underworld, they just went back to the 'other side.'
Guess that basically means they went home?
Aw, come on, that's no fun!
Well, that's how most ghost stories end up turning out.

10011206.t: Sky Lantern Street
Quartet attendants were causing a commotion on the festival street.

Ah!
Fixer, please help me!
How much are you paying?
Talking about money right off the bat?
You've never once lost out by helping me! You're so mean!
The scary thing about you is how you work me to the bone while keeping it just barely above a loss for me.
Anyway, what's going on?
As you can see...

Hey, hand over the candy already!
Or else... we'll play a trick on you!

Hehe...
If you hand over the candy quietly, no one has to get hurt...

These customers have been demanding free candy for a Halloween event...
saying they'll play tricks on me if I don't...
They call it a trick, but it's practically interfering with my business!
Hmm...
Give them candy

Why not just give them some?
Candy, I mean.

I already tried that!
I gave them expensive candy, giant candy, and even whole gift sets of candy, but...
As soon as they finish eating it, they come right back demanding more!

Now I'm almost completely out of candy...
I couldn't give them any more even if I wanted to!

Nah, not regular candy.
You've got something way more fitting for troublemakers like them, don't you?

Y-You don't mean...
Really use that...? Are you sure it'll be okay?
Who cares if it's okay? They're the ones who crossed the line using Halloween as an excuse.
Let's make them pay the price.

Hehe...
Understood.

Alright, everyone...
Here's the candy you wanted so badly!
Nice! Should've just handed it over in the first place!

Hehe... I wonder what this one tastes like...
Shall we give it a try?

...?!
Th-This taste is...!!

I-Inside my mouth...!
The candy is popping and exploding?!

A-And...! It's crazy sour!
I've never had candy this sour in my life!!

Hehe, how do you like the taste?
It's the Blissful Trading Guild's specialty, [Fireworks Festival in Your Mouth]!!
Strong enough to exorcise an aberrant spirit on the spot... Are you sure you're allowed to sell this stuff?

A-Ahaha!
Some customers actually enjoy an extra kick like that, you know!
Let them play their trick

Why not just let them play their trick?
If we show them we won't even flinch, they'll back off, won't they?
Situations like this are all about winning the battle of nerves.

Is that so?
Alright then!

Listen up, everyone! They say the customer is king, but...
even a king shouldn't act so spoiled!

Go ahead and play your tricks if you dare!
We of the Blissful Trading Guild... won't even bat an eye!

H-Huh?
Um... Fixer, the mood's getting a little intense here...
Looks like they're actually going to go through with it.

Th-That's what I mean...
Them playing a trick on me wasn't part of the plan, was it?!
Hey, in business, you never know what's waiting around the corner, right?

Th-That's why...
I asked you to do something about it, <:player>... Haaah!?
Refusing to hand over the candy even after our warning...
That means... you're ready to face... our trick, doesn't it...? Hehehe...

W-Wait a minute, dear customers!
Direct physical contact with the staff is... Hngh?!

You're doing great, hang in there!
Don't let them break your spirit!

And how is keeping my spirit up supposed to work...
when you're running away right now...?!

Running away? Call it a strategic retreat and risk management.
The key to good business is knowing when to cut your losses, right?

Cut your losses?! Fixer...
I trusted you! I trusted you!
Rule number one in this line of work: never trust anyone too easily.

Fixer... Just you wait...!
Next time I'll charge you double... Haaaahn?!
Yomi ended up getting thoroughly ravaged by the angry aberrant spirits' tricks...

10011207.t: Aberrant spirits were making a ruckus in front of the festival bulletin board.

What is the meaning of this?
If you cause a commotion in the street... the Fairwinds Association will have to teach you a lesson.

Hmm, I see...
What is that? You wish to try working here as well?

Hmm, that is quite the dilemma.
I have never heard of hiring aberrant spirits as staff...
...Even so, there may yet be another way.

Huh?
Why are you looking at me?
Because I know my friend will come up with a splendid idea, of course.

What am I, a bottomless pouch of wisdom?
Looks to me like you're carrying a much bigger pair of pouches yourself??
Aahn♡ Still, I have faith that you will find a solution unbound by stuffy old rules, my friend.
Hmm...
What sort of work should we give them?
Haunted house
Well, it's not like there isn't a way.

Truly!?
As expected of my dear friend!
I... heard about your situation... You'd like to rent this place...?
There's really no better spot than right here.

Oh my!
Come to think of it, no shops have been set up here yet.
Well... that's because it's a boundary space... belonging to neither side...
Yeah, that makes it perfect.
Alright, shall we get to work?

Hmph... Is this the place?
This new haunted house they've been talking about...

Hehe...
To think someone would challenge us after we've conquered every single haunted house in the Quartet.

The ghosts are probably just people in costumes anyway...
Let's rip all their masks right off!

Pfft! What is this pathetic getup?
For a ghost costume, it's not scary at all!
Aw, and I had my hopes up. Guess there's really no one here who can satisfy us, huh?

...Huh?
Into the floor...

J-Just now, that thing...
It passed right through us—

I-It's just our imagination, just our imagination!
It just moved super fast and left an afterimage...
Eep...
Eeeeeek!?
The Aberrant Spirits hired at the haunted house put their natural talents to good use, scared the living daylights out of people, and passed on in satisfaction.
Open a food stall
If we want to make a killing at a festival, a food stall is definitely the way to go.

Oh, is that so?
Then let us be off!
You've got customers!

Hehe...
Bring us the most delicious dish you have in this place!

Hmm? What... is this?
I've never seen food like this before... Nom, nom.

Is it because it's Halloween?
The decoration is pretty unique. Nom, nom, nom...

!?
Th-This taste... What on earth is it...?!

Is this... even edible?
Just what kind of ingredients did they use to make this...?!

Whoops...
I guess leaving the cooking to Aberrant Spirits was asking too much, huh?

After all, they are merely imitating humans.
They likely have only a vague sense of taste as well...
It seems opening a restaurant with Aberrant Spirits was too tall an order after all.
Had I known it'd turn out like this, we should've opened a ghost cosplay restaurant instead of a real ghost restaurant.
In the end, customers stopped coming before long, and the restaurant went completely bust...
